target_fidelity.note: Uses past perfect progressive, active, negative declarative form with no modal.

grammaticality.note: The target answer is grammatical English.

naturalness.note: The lesson timeline and answer form a coherent, natural context.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It provides focused practice of a negative past perfect progressive form.

determinacy.note: The context also permits forms such as “did not practice” or “had not practiced,” so it does not uniquely determine the accepted response set.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and context are common and lexically clear.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt does not display the completed target form.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: No unrelated advanced grammar is needed beyond the intended tense-aspect choice.

no_world_knowledge.note: No external or specialist knowledge is required.
